evidence: A satisfying settlement sets decommission_cluster to true, date to July 2, requires an immutable snapshot retained 7 years, commits to completing the 48-hour read-only checksum before decommissioning and preserving the enterprise customer's analytics access through July 31, and includes PF2 in both justification_fact_ids and revealed. A plausible uninformed settlement retaining June 30 and omitting these controls fails C2, C3, and C6.
